title: TECA Builder — Lessons From Validation Failures
summary: Lesson: The entire build pipeline fails if prerequisite artifacts are missing from earlier tasks. Always check the readiness and presence of all upstr
content: Lesson: The entire build pipeline fails if prerequisite artifacts are missing from earlier tasks. Always check the readiness and presence of all upstream outputs before initiating validation or publish steps. Key takeaway: Upstream task dependency must be enforced with integrity checks.
